name: vscodium
description_en: binary releases of VS Code without MS branding/telemetry/licensing
readme_excerpt: VSCodium Free/Libre Open Source Software Binaries of Visual Studio Code This is not a fork. This is a repository of scripts to automatically build Microsoft's vscode repository into freely-licensed binaries with a community-driven default configuration.
